title: Man Calls 911 on Himself Then Points Fake Gun at Officer
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Las Cruces, New Mexico — On July 27, 2025, just before 4 p.m., 21-year-old Dominic Gage Martinez called 911 and stated that he had gotten into an argument with his mother and told dispatch that if police didn’t show up, he was going to shoot her. Martinez also told dispatch that he had a gun and that the argument with his mother was likely going to escalate into a physical altercation. He refused to answer any further questions and ended the call. Officers arrived at the 1900 block of Embassy Drive apartment complex to find Martinez inside. Body camera footage revealed the moment Martinez emerged from the apartment holding what appeared to be a firearm and pointed it at an officer. The officer fired four shots in response, though none struck Martinez. The gun was later identified as a BB gun. Martinez was subdued using non-lethal force and transported to a hospital before being booked into jail. Martinez now faces multiple charges, including aggravated assault upon a peace officer, assault against a household member, and resisting, evading, or obstructing an officer.
